name: STAC Catalog
abstract: A SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs (STAC) catalog.  This building block implements validation of examples using the canonical schema and a JSON-LD context to a map to a RDF format that can support richer logical constraints and integration with related data.

examples.title: STAC Catalog v1.1.0
examples.content: Ref to STAC example from current version (1.1.0)

examples.title: STAC Catalog v1.0.0
examples.content: Ref to STAC example using version (1.0.0)

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: STAC Catalog Specification
description: This object represents Catalogs in a SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (adapted
  from official specs)
allOf:
- $ref: '#/definitions/catalog'
- $ref: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/master/item-spec/json-schema/common.json
definitions:
  catalog:
    title: STAC Catalog
    description: These are the fields specific to a STAC Catalog.
    type: object
    $comment: title and description are validated through the common metadata. stac_version
      is required by the version-specific building blocks.
    required:
    - type
    - id
    - description
    - links
    properties:
      stac_extensions:
        title: STAC extensions
        type: array
        uniqueItems: true
        items:
          title: Reference to a JSON Schema
          type: string
          format: iri
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/stac/core/hasExtension
      type:
        title: Type of STAC entity
        const: Catalog
        x-jsonld-id: '@type'
      id:
        title: Identifier
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        x-jsonld-id: '@id'
      links:
        type: array
        items:
          $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/ogc-utils/json-link/schema.yaml
        x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#seeAlso
x-jsonld-extra-terms:
  stac_version: https://w3id.org/ogc/stac/core/version
  Catalog: https://w3id.org/ogc/stac/core/Catalog
  title: http://purl.org/dc/terms/title
  description: http://purl.org/dc/terms/description
  keywords: http://purl.org/dc/terms/subject
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  stac: https://w3id.org/ogc/stac/core/
  dct: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  rdfs: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: ogc.contrib.stac.catalog
  register: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-stac/build/register.json
  version: 1.1.0
  dateOfLastChange: '2026-11-25'
